claim_text: Accumulated executable history increased the findability of exact solutions to independently defined, oracle-reachable tasks under fixed metered budgets (M1 - M0 = +10.95pp CFR, p = 0.0007).
source_quote: Accumulated executable history increased the findability of exact solutions to independently defined, oracle-reachable tasks under fixed metered budgets: M1 − M0 = **+10.95pp CFR** (p = 0.0007 one-sided paired permutation, task-level n = 42, effect 3.2 SE above zero).
verdict_metric: +10.95pp CFR, p=0.0007 one-sided paired permutation, n=42 tasks, 3.2 SE above zero; margin over the preregistered 10pp floor is 0.95pp against SE 3.4pp; vs M0b-POP +10.0pp, p=0.013
gate: Preregistered G4 gate with 10pp floor; all analysis from pre-committed hashed script (results/compute_gates.py, hashed before any M1 row was read); thresholds frozen before evidence
qualifications: The EXISTENCE of the advantage is decisive, the floor clearance is knife-edge (disclosed, <1 SE); no claim of intelligence, cognition, understanding, or AGI; claim is relative to fixed metered search budgets
substrate: M1 vs M0 arms on a preflight-valid substrate; 42 non-control tasks, fixed metered budgets, machine verdict in results/gates_verdict.json
mechanism_hint: an admissible library of previously executed, ecology-adapted artifacts causally raised the probability of finding exact solutions
consumer_hint: successor generation designing task ecologies where library content cannot saturate (non-stationary families, composition chains, non-INSERT-complete physics)
related_hints: constitution s43 'M1 improves by carrying a library' outcome

claim_text: The D-5 history advantage is a library-content effect (possessing ecology-adapted executable artifacts, in any order), not a developmental-correspondence effect: shuffled history retains 100% of the advantage while a size-matched random library retains 39%.
source_quote: The advantage is therefore a **library-content effect** — possessing ecology-adapted executable artifacts, in any order — not a developmental- correspondence effect. Consistent with that: no developmental trend (G6, late-vs-early ≈ 0) and no significant frozen alien transfer (G7, +5pp, p = 0.26).
verdict_metric: M1-shuffled-history retains 100% of the advantage (77 vs 80 solves; 94/290 rows differ); M1-random-library retains 39%; G6 late-vs-early -0.001 p=0.49; G7 alien +5pp p=0.26
gate: G9 causal-decomposition gate, frozen before evidence; G9 failed by design of the gate (shuffled retention 1.0, random retention 0.39)
qualifications: P6 NOT ESTABLISHED (advantage not attributable to correspondent developmental structure) and P7 NOT ESTABLISHED (no acceleration over developmental time); P4 HACR 2.13 underpowered (CI90 [0.93, 3.70], n=13); the +6pp CTRL delta hints at a generic diversity-injection component measured directly by the 39% random-library retention
substrate: G9 decomposition arms: M1-shuffled-history (same artifacts, permuted task order) and M1-random-library (size-matched random-walk genotypes)
mechanism_hint: library content, in any order, carries the advantage; developmental sequencing carries none in this ecology
consumer_hint: successor should meter diversity injection as an explicit baseline arm
related_hints: gate table G6/G7/G9 in the same verdict

claim_text: Externally defined tasks on a preflight-valid substrate were 0/48 findable under the pointwise exact-match objective while substrate-emitted targets were 57% reachable; the emitted-vs-external findability gap is an obstacle D-4-style geometry assays cannot see.
source_quote: **Needle-landscape discovery**: externally defined tasks on a preflight-valid substrate were 0/48 findable under the pointwise exact-match objective; substrate-EMITTED targets were 57% reachable. The gap between emitted-phenotype accessibility and external-task findability is the central obstacle D-4-style geometry assays cannot see.
verdict_metric: 0/48 external tasks findable under pointwise exact match; 57% of substrate-emitted targets reachable; deterministic bitwise partial credit restored a gradient (depth-1 ~80%, depth-2 ~40-60%, depth-3 ~20% at 30k)
gate: listed under 'What this generation established beyond the gates' in a preregistered-gate verdict document
qualifications: Findability is per-primitive heterogeneous even at depth 1 (SHRC 8/8 vs MULC3 0/8 at 8000 evals): task-level replication is mandatory; single attempts measure seed luck
substrate: preflight-valid D-5 substrate, pointwise exact-match objective, 30k evaluation budgets
mechanism_hint: needle landscape: exact-match objective offers no gradient toward external targets; s23 bitwise partial credit restores a soft findability gradient
related_hints: agent_d4_blind/VERDICT-PHASE1.md (geometry assays this gap is invisible to)

claim_text: For INSERT-complete mutation physics, reachability equals expressibility (R == E): every expressible witness is reachable by an explicit edge-checked path, so reachability can never be the failure mode and every failure on an expressible task is a findability failure.
source_quote: P1 PASS (structural): R == E theorem — INSERT-complete physics makes every expressible witness reachable by an explicit edge-checked path (<= 26 steps). Reachability carries no information in this generation; every failure on an expressible task is a findability failure. DISCLOSED.
verdict_metric: explicit edge-checked paths <= 26 steps for all 78 tasks; P0 78/78 constructive witnesses
gate: P1 claim-ladder gate, PASS (structural), disclosed
qualifications: A successor wanting a live reachability axis needs physics without universal single-edit insertion; validated here only on ablated-physics synthetic cases
substrate: D-5 INSERT-complete mutation physics; 78 tasks with committed expressibility witnesses and reachability paths
mechanism_hint: universal single-edit insertion makes reachability structurally free, collapsing the three-way failure split to findability
consumer_hint: successor generations choosing mutation physics with a live reachability axis

claim_text: D-4 Phase 1 established accessibility geometry on 2 of 4 substrates (S4_MEM robust, S2_STACK marginal): under the frozen physics, executable behavioral change forms a diverse, reproducibly navigable geometry under multiple generic history-free search processes without single-mechanism or encoding privilege.
source_quote: For S4_MEM (and, with the two disclosures, S2_STACK): "Under the frozen computational physics, executable behavioral change forms a substantially diverse, reproducibly navigable accessibility geometry under multiple generic history-free search processes, without evidence that navigation is dominated by any single designer-privileged mutation mechanism or by the particular binary encoding."
verdict_metric: ACCESSIBILITY_GEOMETRY_ESTABLISHED: S2_STACK, S4_MEM (2 of 4). S4_MEM: viability 0.593 [0.583, 0.602]; N2 pooled 0.522 CI [0.38, 0.67] clearing the 0.25 gate; far stratum N2 0.53; re-findability 0.69-0.71; worst privilege ablation z = 0.77
gate: All gates frozen before any measurement (PREREG-PHASE1.md, hashes in anti_cheat/frozen_hashes.json); instrument v4 validated on all 8 synthetic pathology controls at binding scale before freeze
qualifications: Does NOT establish AGI, intelligence, understanding, autonomous diagnosis, human-independent cognition, elimination of human priors, or open-ended evolution; scoped to two frozen substrates under a 1,200-evaluation budget, 8 frozen probes, d1 <= 0.10 hit ball; S1_REG -> NAVIGATION_FAILURE (far stratum dead: N2 0.00 vs gate 0.10); S4 is the load-bearing basis
substrate: four frozen computational substrates (S1_REG, S2_STACK, S3_REWRITE, S4_MEM), blind accessibility geometry, generic history-free navigators, 1,200-eval budget
mechanism_hint: graceful degradation across the whole mutation menu (the C5-navigable signature); no single-mechanism ablation approaches the privilege gate on S4
consumer_hint: Phase-2 preregistration MAY now be designed targeting S4_MEM (primary) and S2_STACK (secondary); no Phase-2 execution authorized by this verdict

claim_text: S2_STACK's Phase 1 pass is marginal: the pooled navigation pass sits within cluster-level noise of the gate, and removing OP1 (cell substitution) drops far hits by rel 0.72 at z = 1.85, just under the frozen z = 1.96 privilege threshold.
source_quote: Privilege: DISCLOSURE 2 — removing OP1 (cell substitution) drops far hits by rel 0.72 at z = 1.85, just under the frozen z = 1.96. The gate did not fire; the margin is reported because it is the closest privilege call in the generation, and the human-taxonomy red team notes OP1 is the mechanism whose edits most often change I/O-instruction counts (30% of its effective transitions).
verdict_metric: N2 pooled 0.333, N4 0.344 vs frozen 0.25 gate but cluster-bootstrap CIs ([0.19, 0.48], [0.22, 0.48]) include the gate; OP1 ablation rel drop 0.72 at z = 1.85 vs frozen z = 1.96; far stratum 0.15 vs gate 0.10
gate: frozen 0.25 point-estimate navigation gate and frozen z = 1.96 privilege threshold; both disclosures reported because gates did not fire
qualifications: DISCLOSURE 1: the pooled pass is within cluster-level noise of the gate; DISCLOSURE 2: closest privilege call in the generation; a successor generation testing S2 should treat OP1-dependence as the first thing to probe; the human-taxonomy red team WEAKENS the S2 pass narrative
substrate: S2_STACK substrate, 36 navigation targets, budget 1,200 evaluations, single-mechanism ablations

claim_text: S3_REWRITE was killed as a learning substrate despite the highest validity/viability (0.996) and largest phenotype mass of the four substrates: its accessibility geometry is dead, with far-stratum hits 0.00 for every navigator and oracle far episode-reach 0.00 across ~1.5M metered evaluations.
source_quote: with a dead accessibility geometry: far-stratum hits 0.00 for every navigator, and oracle far episode-reach 0.00 — across ~1.5M metered evaluations, not one observed viable path led from any episode's starts into any far target's ball. Deep-rewrite phenotypes appear on target-generation walks and are then unreachable again: one-off lottery phenotypes.
verdict_metric: ACCESSIBILITY_FRAGMENTED; viability 0.996 [0.995, 0.997]; 11,717 combined phenotype classes, unseen mass 0.99; far-stratum hits 0.00 for every navigator; oracle far episode-reach 0.00 over ~1.5M metered evaluations
gate: frozen far-stratum navigation gates and oracle-reach diagnostics per PREREG-PHASE1.md; the charter's central warning made flesh (s.4, s.22)
qualifications: Validity is a coordinate, not the objective; diversity is a coordinate, not the objective. S3 maximized both and failed the only property that matters for a learning substrate
substrate: S3_REWRITE (random rule tables; almost every random table is a viable input-sensitive program)
mechanism_hint: deep-rewrite phenotypes are one-off lottery phenotypes: they appear on target-generation walks and are then unreachable again

source_quote: VERDICT         NO_BASIS_PASSED  -- generation stops. No worlds, no learner. No basis passed the preregistered precondition set G1-G10. Under the frozen precedence rules none of the preregistered verdict *terms* matched either, because every basis failed and no single failure mode was universal.

source_quote: **Free validity and rich viable navigation did not co-occur in any of the four bases.** The two properties traded off cleanly across the family:
verdict_metric: P(valid|r=1)/best M0 coverage: S1 1.000/0.533, S2 1.000/0.400, S3 0.440/0.317, S4 1.000/0.100; S3 viability collapses 0.440 -> 0.222 -> 0.128 -> 0.045 -> 0.022 across r = 1,2,3,5,8; S4: 6,019 census classes, giant component 0.24, zero mid/far-stratum hits

claim_text: D-3's preregistered taxonomy-neutrality gate G6 is near-tautological: each frozen edit operator maps onto exactly one human family, so the measured family distribution is a relabelling of the experimenter's own uniform sampling over operators, and whatever G6 measured, it was not the substrate.
source_quote: **A taxonomy-neutrality gate built from a classifier over the mutation operator's output shapes cannot distinguish "the physics does not privilege human categories" from "I sampled my six edit operators uniformly, and each one is a human category."** Whatever G6 measured, it was not the substrate.
verdict_metric: operator->family confusion on S2/S3/S4: E-DELETE->delete 1.00, E-SUBST->relabel 0.98-1.00, E-DUPBLOCK->duplication 0.97-1.00, E-TRANSPOSE->permutation 0.86-0.89, E-SPLICE->splice 0.85-0.93; on S1, E-SWAP produced an identical token string in 100% of 806 sampled draws (a dead operator undetected before freeze)
gate: the preregistered G6 verdict stands as computed (results/phase1_verdict.json); the diagnostic is not load-bearing for the stop (no basis reaches 10/10 either way)
qualifications: G6's aggregated form additionally conflates operator bias with composition depth (splice degenerates to catch-all at composed radii); a real test must derive family assignment from behavioural parent-child relations with operator identity held out; also G4 is vacuous wherever validity is total, and G3 rewards the pathology G8 punishes
substrate: D-3's frozen mutation operator menu and substrate-generic syntactic taxonomy, atomic-operator confusion table over sampled draws
mechanism_hint: the operator menu and the family taxonomy are the same object seen twice
consumer_hint: successor experiments: never measure taxonomy neutrality with a classifier over the mutation operator's own output shapes; audit operators for dead members before freezing

qualifications: K2 answered by scoping in the open: bidirectional search over inverse primitives solves these tasks in ~1e3 node visits, so every v1 cost claim is relative to the forward-composition solver class; ablation restores P0 counter-identically
substrate: forward-composition tree/BFS solvers over register worlds wA/wB/wC (moduli 997/673/809), boundary-only task access, five seeds

source_quote: Revision: learned guard `comp0(s)<161 OR comp0(r02(s))<161` — the trap boundary m//5 = 161 recovered exactly from failure evidence. Out-of-sample failure prediction by seed: 1.0 / 0.9975 / 1.0 / 1.0 / 1.0. gate: wC negative-transfer and revision cells preregistered in incubation_v1.py::PREREG; detection without labels: runtime-failure rate 0.3013 in wC vs exactly 0 in wA and wB
qualifications: Bounded, not repaired: hostile node harm persists under the guard (2.9097) because hostile tasks are hostile at the task level (minimal solutions avoid M) — unreachable by any state predicate; recorded as c0001's failure region

claim_text: The first full 5-seed run of incubation v1 passed every preregistered gate but was thrown out because the anti-cheat battery found 6 witness-word collisions between wA and wB cells — a measurement-independence defect — and the full rerun was done with witness words sampled without replacement.
source_quote: The first full 5-seed run passed every preregistered gate — and failed the anti-cheat battery: 6 witness-word collisions between wA and wB cells. Not a solver-visible leak; a measurement-independence defect: tree-search cost is nearly a deterministic function of the witness word, so shared words made transfer cells partially re-test wA search trees.
verdict_metric: 6 witness-word collisions between wA and wB cells; the discarded run's numbers were materially identical to the rerun
gate: anti-cheat battery as referee over a run that passed all preregistered gates
qualifications: The discarded run's numbers were materially identical — which is precisely why the battery, not judgment, had to be the referee; fix wired into the generator (witness words sampled without replacement across every cell of a replicate)
substrate: incubation v1 5-seed run, wA/wB transfer cells, witness-word task generator
mechanism_hint: tree-search cost is nearly a deterministic function of the witness word, so shared words made transfer cells partially re-test wA search trees
related_hints: memory: witness words must be sampled without replacement

claim_text: The v2 trap world dD distinguished behaviorally equivalent operator variants that admission could not (the ALT-scheduling seed paid 33x), and the failure-driven revision router then erased the trap harm to +0.9% probe overhead while keeping the operator on clean worlds.
source_quote: Trap (dD blind): pooled harm 2.26 [2.12, 4.86]; the seed whose operator used ALT scheduling paid 33x — the trap distinguished operator variants that admission could not, which is exactly what World D exists to do. Blind solve rate fell to 0.91. Detection: 9-14/14 runs anomalous per seed; the backward-edge audit flagged 100% of anomalous runs and 0 clean runs.

claim_text: All three worlds authored to instantiate named strategic realms were inadmissible: a one-ply greedy heuristic picks an optimal action in 85-100% of states and four plies of trivial search essentially solves all three, so a world can instantiate a named strategic realm completely and contain no strategic decision.
source_quote: Four plies of trivial search essentially solves all three. **A world can instantiate a named strategic realm completely and contain no strategic decision.**
verdict_metric: one-ply greedy optimal-action rates: LOOM 100.0%, WEIR 85.7%, TITHE 85.0%; depth-4 gaps 0.000/0.012/0.040; all worlds solved exactly by backward induction
gate: GATE-W1 admissibility (a world is inadmissible at an axis if a cheap policy already solves it, keyed on the gap at search depth 4)
qualifications: An LLM measured on these worlds (nvidia:gpt-oss-120b) was statistically identical to the four-line heuristic at the optimal-action rung (McNemar p = 0.500 and p = 1.000); its 0.900 exact game-value headline did not survive stratification — 7/17 (0.412) where 5+ plies remained — a property of the sampler, not the model; all real-game rules are HYPOTHESIZED reconstructions
substrate: three authored solitaire worlds (LOOM resource conversion, WEIR spatial control, TITHE descending-price auction), exact DP solutions, no sampling
mechanism_hint: realm instantiation and strategic depth are independent; uniform state sampling over-weights near-terminal positions

claim_text: Push-your-luck is a real family and nearly empty: the untuned stop rule r0003 retains 0.9991 of optimal in Flip 7 and 0.9095 transplanted untuned into Martian Dice, but axis ablation shows the shared computation accounts for almost none of the harder world's residual — the genre label groups those games by their shared easy part.
source_quote: Paired with a competent claim rule, the transplanted stopper retains **0.9872**. So the shared computation is real and transfers across a wide surface gap — and accounts for almost none of what makes the harder world hard. **The genre label groups those games by their shared *easy* part.**
verdict_metric: r0003 retains 0.9991 (Flip 7), 0.9095 (Martian Dice, untuned, beating every hand-tuned threshold); of the 0.0905 residual, upgrading only the stop rule -0.0005 vs upgrading only the claim rule +0.0777 (86% of the residual); paired retention 0.9872
gate: exact solutions (no sampling); fitted-per-world non-transferable baseline; visitation weighting under competent play
qualifications: Worlds are solitaire, small, and reconstructed from memory (HYPOTHESIZED rules); all numbers are policy scores, not learning-cost measurements
substrate: Flip 7 and Martian Dice, solved exactly; circuit r0003 (STOP iff P(death|continue) * pot >= E[immediate gain|continue]) written only against a compiled transition table
mechanism_hint: transfer is mediated by interfaces, not by games or genres — the organising bet stated so it can be killed

claim_text: r0003's scope prediction, registered before Incan Gold and Can't Stop were built, passed prospectively (both worlds returned 1.0000 with the residual localising exactly as predicted), while the SELECT circuit ordering completely and unpredictedly reversed between two worlds sharing an interface.
source_quote: `r0003`'s scope prediction (≥ 0.97 with a competent SELECT partner; residual localises off the stop axis) was registered **before Incan Gold and Can't Stop were built**. Both returned **1.0000**, and Can't Stop's residual localised exactly as predicted (SELECT +0.0611, STOP +0.0000).
verdict_metric: 1.0000 retention in both preregistered worlds; beats the fitted-per-world baseline in all four worlds (0.9976 / 0.9223 / 0.9448 / 0.9405); unpredicted reversal: r0011 0.2501 in Martian Dice (worst, below the null circuit's 0.7398) vs 0.9389 in Can't Stop (best)
gate: scope prediction registered before the test worlds were built; circuit ledger with predicted_worlds, predicted_direction, kill_condition
qualifications: The reversal was unpredicted: r0011 is the worst circuit available in one world and the best in the other; the first proposed mechanism for the reversal was refuted by its own test (correlation sign opposite: measured -0.0623 and +0.2390) and replaced by the w0001 gating-fraction property; a registered kill condition was mis-specified (named the reversal 'outside push-your-luck' and it occurred inside it)
substrate: Incan Gold and Can't Stop (built after registration), Flip 7, Martian Dice; exact solutions, SELECT/STOP axis decomposition
mechanism_hint: w0001 gating fraction (share of states whose pot is exactly zero despite capacity spent): FLIP7 0.0002, INCAN_GOLD 0.0001, MARTIAN_DICE 0.4272, CANT_STOP 0.0000

claim_text: The cycle 004 verdict CONTEXTUAL_BASIS_REQUIRED was demoted to CHALLENGED-AND-NOT-SUSTAINED: under a common reference distribution of decision states the circuit main effect dominates (0.8528) and circuit x world collapses to 0.1021, so much of what was called contextual competence was support mismatch (exposure, not competence).
source_quote: **Under a common reference distribution of decision states, the circuit main effect dominates (0.8528) and `circuit x world` collapses to 0.1021.** Cycle 004 measured 0.2126 / 0.4374 on the same worlds. The review was right: a large part of what was called contextual competence was **support mismatch**. [...] `CONTEXTUAL_BASIS_REQUIRED` (cycle 004) is **DEMOTED to CHALLENGED-AND-NOT-SUSTAINED.**
verdict_metric: reference-occupancy decomposition (real worlds): circuit 0.8528, world 0.0451, circuit x world 0.1021 vs cycle 004 on-policy 0.2126 / 0.0696 / 0.4374; the three weightings disagree violently (circuit x world = 0.1021 / 0.2289 / 0.6222); cross-world rank: real mean tau +0.1079 with 3 of 6 pairs negative, FOUNDRY +0.7981
gate: replacement class EXPOSURE_CONFOUNDED_HETEROGENEITY registered with its own kill condition (if a common-reference decomposition on >= 4 worlds returns circuit x world > circuit, the class is wrong); fossil discipline applied to verdicts (cycle 004 document not rewritten)
qualifications: Cycle 004's 'what survives is rank, not magnitude' is wrong as applied to worlds (cross-world rank does not survive; half the real world pairs negatively correlated); the sharper finding: WHERE a circuit is wrong is world-conditional, but how much its errors cost where competent play goes is largely circuit-determined; FOUNDRY says worlds rescale while reconstructed worlds say worlds reorder — the synthetic block would have misled; r_i(W) is NOT built and the world-property registry is deferred
substrate: 21 solved worlds (reconstructed named worlds + FOUNDRY synthetics), per-decision regret against the optimal continuation under three state weightings, zero model calls, all quantities exact
mechanism_hint: E_ijk is an on-policy outcome measuring exposure x conditional competence as a product; self-occupancy is circular and uniform weighting counts states no competent play reaches — reference occupancy under optimal play is the defensible weighting
consumer_hint: reference-weighted conditional regret becomes the primary estimand; the review's four-arm learning-cost design adopted with 'D must beat C' as the decisive criterion

claim_text: D6-A's central hypothesis — that relational executable history can construct a derived signal that causally increases exact-solver findability on held-out tasks beyond the artifact hoard — was not confirmed: a clean preregistered null (H3-H1 +0.010, p=0.4875 vs a >=+0.20 requirement), with machine verdict ENDOGENOUS_SIGNAL_FOUND but explicitly NOT CAUSAL_FINDABILITY_SIGNAL.
source_quote: The central hypothesis — that relational executable history can construct a derived signal that causally increases exact-solver findability on held-out tasks beyond the artifact hoard — was **not confirmed** in this generation. The result is a clean preregistered null with an identified mechanistic bottleneck (see §Interpretation).
verdict_metric: T-P3 H3-H1 (CONF) +0.010 [-0.010, +0.042] p=0.4875 FAIL (needed >= +0.20, p<0.01); T-P4 H3-H2 +0.000 p=0.7444 FAIL; T-P5 ALIEN zero-shot 0/144 both arms; Holm over primaries FAIL; battery VALID (V1-V5 pass); sparse wall CONFIRMED (M0 CONF 0.007, tier3 0/576)
gate: All evidence frozen per prereg/PREREG_D6A.md (+ amendments 1-3 logged before any Z/M1 evidence); no within-generation rescue after evidence froze; anti-cheat probes ALL PASS
qualifications: The null is informative: the interface ceiling was measured before the null — even a designer-side truth-seeded z moved dev-tier2 solves only 5/24 -> 9/24, so the bottleneck is the ordering-only coupling, not the history; development worked in-distribution (~40x DEV tier2 improvement); geometry moved (10x on-manifold concentration) while solve rate did not; a successor needs a constructive rather than purely selective interface, which under §24 cannot be retrofitted
substrate: frozen physics/grammar/selection interface; arms H1 (hoard), H2, H3, RANDZ, Z0ARM; CONF 24 tasks x 12 seeds x 200k metered oracle calls
mechanism_hint: tournament-k reordering of draws from frozen proposal physics has a low transmission ceiling: rank-only pressure delivers at most ~10x concentration per slot before diversity collapse, far below what exact-solution acquisition needed
consumer_hint: successor generation with a preregistered interface whose expressive locus is constructive (z-conditioned composition proposals) — closer to the sibling graph-alteration design (D7)

claim_text: D-7's history-conditioned synthesizer H2, given only machine-native relational history of 32 artifacts, found a nonlinear topology-changing transform crossing a certified base-physics barrier in a median 23.5 evaluations vs 73 for the strongest history-free baseline, 65.5 with relational edges removed, and 86 with edges shuffled — verdict CERTIFIED_NONLINEAR_WORMHOLE.
source_quote: Given only machine-native relational history of 32 artifacts (marginal + pairwise interaction) on unrelated developmental worlds, a history-conditioned synthesizer (**H2**) finds a crossing in a median **23.5** evaluations vs **73** for the strongest history-free baseline (3.1×, p≈0), **65.5** for the same hoard with edges removed (H0), and **86** for shuffled edges (H1).
verdict_metric: H2 median 23.5 evals vs Z0-sample 73 (3.1x, p~=0), H0 65.5 (2.79x), H1 86 (3.66x); barrier certified exactly (closure + conserved invariant, auditor-upgraded to a 169-element operator monoid for any path length); geometry opens 13 -> 2197 states; transfer Z-MECH 7.5 vs Z0 116; verdicts CERTIFIED_NONLINEAR_WORMHOLE, MOTIF_TRANSFER_ONLY, WORMHOLE_WITH_REVISION
gate: All machine verdicts frozen before evidence and before any human interpretation; pre-registered falsifiers (cut not exact, single artifact crosses, H0/H1 ~= H2, affine/separable transform, endpoint leakage, vacuous transfer world); 7/7 independent auditors SOUND, no defects; decisive auditor-added control: planting H2's exact weight multiset on random artifacts removes the speedup
qualifications: Findability numbers are budget-relative, not impossibility; byte-level transfer fails by design (mechanism transfers: MOTIF_TRANSFER_ONLY); effect magnitudes are seed-sensitive (H2 2.3x on a 6-seed slice vs 3.1x full); the mechanism depends on the gated writer being marginally invisible, a designed property of this world; scale deliberately small (p=13, <=2197 states); H3 (ancestry-destroyed) not cleanly definable on this substrate
substrate: 3-register micro-ISA mod 13 (2197 states), frozen base physics touching only r, 32-artifact hoard with gated nonlinear s-writer (s += r*r), generic synthesis grammar with no solution-shaped API
mechanism_hint: relational (pairwise) history identifies the gate-opener/gated-writer pair that neither marginal statistics (H0) nor shuffled wiring (H1) can; the transform is non-affine, non-separable, context-dependent
related_hints: SerendipityFoundry/D6A/REPORT_D6A.md (the selective-interface null this constructive design answers)

claim_text: D-8's blind serendipity incubator returned S0 NO_EFFECT: accumulated executable history produced no statistically distinguishable improvement in exact task acquisition over the strongest history-free baseline under equal metered resources, and the null is informative because the instrument was validated sensitive before freeze.
source_quote: Accumulated executable history, as constructed by this generation's machinery, produced NO statistically distinguishable improvement in exact task acquisition over the strongest history-free baseline under equal metered resources (delta = +0.100, 95% CI [-0.033, +0.233], exact McNemar p = 0.210). Zero of eight promoted z-candidates were admitted. The instrument was validated sensitive BEFORE freeze (planted useful object: gain 1.00, ablation loss 1.00), so this null is informative -- a property of the ecology + learner, not of a blind instrument.
verdict_metric: S0 -- NO_EFFECT (frozen mapping, computed once, untouched); PRIMARY G1: M1F .483 vs M0b .383, delta +0.100, 95% CI [-0.033, +0.233], exact McNemar p = 0.210; 0/8 promoted z-candidates admitted
gate: Frozen verdict ladder S0-S5 with frozen thresholds (PREREG.md sec 8-10); EXECUTE -> MEASURE -> ADMIT/REJECT -> FREEZE -> ONLY THEN INTERPRET; frozen comparator rule selected M0b as primary baseline (conservative: GA-based M1 must beat a different, stronger baseline); row-wise budget audit fail-closed with ZERO violations
qualifications: Instrument sensitivity validated pre-freeze via planted useful object (gain 1.00, ablation loss 1.00), so the null is a property of the ecology + learner, not of a blind instrument; preregistered design ceiling S3, with S4/S5 declared unlikely in the anti-tautology audit
